Commands left in the inner set
Tasks of the phase at launch; tasks the unit named
Kind of the newest integrity event of the phase attempt, or absent
Error of the check runner, or absent
Per command: flagged flaky; measured duration. Per phase attempt: share of time in inner checks; ordinal of the cycle
The failure signature equals that of the proposal before

The next rung of the pinned ladder or absent; whether it equals a critic-class call of the run in model and in effort (true only when both are equal); whether it shares the model of a critic-class call and differs in effort; whether its quota is exhausted; whether the budget of the role allows it

tools.when: commandDuration greater than the time limit of the command
cycle greater than 2, checkShare greater than the cap, and the command is the slowest of the set

loop.when: cyclesLeft equal 0, or unresolvedUnits not less than the cap
innerCount equal 0 and uncheckedStreak not less than 2
phaseTasks equal 1, or unitTasks equal phaseTasks at the first unit

not signatureRepeated, or repairsUsed not equal 1
escalationsTask not less than 1, or escalationsAttempt not less than 2
targetIsCriticModel (equal in model and in effort)
